const {chromium}=require('playwright');
const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),assert=require('node:assert/strict');
const URL=process.env.QA_URL||'http://127.0.0.1:4186/2d/?qa';
const out=path.join(__dirname,'sky-browser');fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});
const report={scope:'Staged feature and responsive smoke checks; not evidence of level playability.',checks:[],layouts:[],errors:[]};
const progressKey='mosslight-pixel-progress';
function ok(value,message){assert.ok(value,message);report.checks.push(message)}
async function ready(page){await page.goto(URL);await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.__pixelQA&&pixelInfo().loaded);}
async function storageContext(browser,storage={},options={}){const context=await browser.newContext({viewport:{width:1440,height:900},...options});await context.addInitScript(values=>{for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(values))localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(value))},storage);const page=await context.newPage();page.on('pageerror',e=>report.errors.push(String(e)));page.on('console',m=>{if(m.type()==='error')report.errors.push(m.text())});await ready(page);return {context,page}}
async function completeStaged(page,index){await page.evaluate(index=>{__pixelQA.begin(index);const w=__pixelQA.world(),g=w.level.ground.at(-1),boss=w.enemies.find(e=>e.type==='boss');boss.hp=0;boss.dead=true;Object.assign(w.player,{x:w.level.length-95,y:g.y-w.player.h,vx:0,vy:0,grounded:true,on:g.id});},index);await page.waitForFunction(()=>pixelInfo().mode==='complete');}
async function checkGodSynced(page,enabled){assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().godMode),enabled);assert.deepEqual(await page.locator('[data-god-toggle]').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>e.getAttribute('aria-pressed'))),[String(enabled),String(enabled),String(enabled)]);}
async function fits(page,selector,label){const boxes=await page.locator(selector).evaluateAll(es=>es.filter(e=>e.getClientRects().length).map(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(),top=document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2);return {id:e.id||e.dataset.key||e.dataset.level||e.dataset.character,x:r.x,y:r.y,right:r.right,bottom:r.bottom,w:r.width,h:r.height,hit:!!top&&(top===e||e.contains(top)),text:e.innerText}}));const {width,height}=page.viewportSize();assert.ok(boxes.length,label+' has controls');for(const b of boxes){assert.ok(b.x>=-1&&b.y>=-1&&b.right<=width+1&&b.bottom<=height+1,label+' clipped: '+JSON.stringify(b));assert.ok(b.hit,label+' obscured: '+JSON.stringify(b))}return boxes}
(async()=>{const browser=await chromium.launch({channel:'msedge',headless:true});let current;
try{
 // Complete the two prior chapters in both orders by staging their finish conditions.
 for(const order of [[0,1],[1,0]]){const {context,page}=await storageContext(browser);current=page;
  ok(await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true','Fresh third chapter locked ('+order+')');
  await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').evaluate(e=>e.click());assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().level),0);
  ok(await page.evaluate(()=>__pixelQA.begin(2))===false,'Actual begin rejects locked chapter ('+order+')');
  await page.click('#god-menu');await checkGodSynced(page,true);ok(await page.evaluate(()=>__pixelQA.begin(2))===false,'God toggle cannot bypass unlock ('+order+')');await page.keyboard.press('KeyG');await checkGodSynced(page,false);
  await completeStaged(page,order[0]);ok(await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true','Only one completion remains locked ('+order+')');
  await completeStaged(page,order[1]);ok(await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='false','Second completion immediately unlocks third ('+order+')');
  assert.deepEqual(await page.evaluate(key=>JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)).completed,progressKey),[true,true,false]);
  await page.reload();await page.waitForFunction(()=>pixelInfo().loaded);ok(await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='false','Both completions persist after reload ('+order+')');
  await page.click('[data-level="2"]');await page.click('#start');assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().level),2);await context.close();
 }
 for(const [legacy,unlocked] of [[{0:620,1:940},true],[{0:620},false],[{0:0,1:940},false]]){const {context,page}=await storageContext(browser,{'mosslight-pixel-best':legacy});current=page;ok((await page.locator('[data-level="2"]').getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='false')===unlocked,'Legacy score migration '+JSON.stringify(legacy));await context.close()}
 const {context,page}=await storageContext(browser,{[progressKey]:{version:1,completed:[true,true,false]}});current=page;
 await page.click('[data-level="2"]');await page.click('#start');await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
 await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__pixelQA.world();w.player.hp=3;w.score=1234;w.collected.add(0);w.kills=2});
 const stable=()=>page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__pixelQA.world();return {level:w.level.index,x:w.player.x,y:w.player.y,hp:w.player.hp,score:w.score,collected:[...w.collected],kills:w.kills,checkpoint:w.checkpoint,deaths:w.deaths}});
 const before=await stable();await page.click('#god-pause');await checkGodSynced(page,true);assert.deepEqual(await stable(),before);await page.keyboard.press('KeyG');await checkGodSynced(page,false);assert.deepEqual(await stable(),before);ok(true,'Pause toggle and G preserve level, position, HP and progression');
 await page.click('#resume');await page.click('#god-hud');await checkGodSynced(page,true);
 const flightStart=await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y);await page.keyboard.down('KeyW');await page.waitForTimeout(250);await page.keyboard.up('KeyW');const raised=await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y);ok(raised<flightStart-35,'God mode rises with W');await page.waitForTimeout(280);ok(Math.abs((await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y))-raised)<3,'God mode hovers without gravity');await page.keyboard.down('KeyS');await page.waitForTimeout(220);await page.keyboard.up('KeyS');ok((await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y))>raised+25,'God mode descends with S');
 const invincible=await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__pixelQA.world(),hp=w.player.hp;return {hurt:w.hurt(2,w.player.x+100),hpBefore:hp,hpAfter:w.player.hp}});ok(invincible.hurt===false&&invincible.hpBefore===invincible.hpAfter,'God mode prevents damage');
 await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
 const targets=await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__pixelQA.world(),p=w.player,cv=document.getElementById('game'),view={x:pixelInfo().camera,y:-Math.max(0,cv.height*.76-420),w:cv.width,h:cv.height};const normal=w.enemies.filter(e=>e.type!=='boss'),boss=w.enemies.find(e=>e.type==='boss');const place=(e,x,y)=>Object.assign(e,{x,y,baseY:y,home:{x:x-100,y:y+e.h,w:500},timer:10,vx:0,vy:0,dead:false,hp:e.maxHp,hitBy:-1});place(normal[0],view.x+350,200);place(boss,view.x+600,200);place(normal[1],view.x+view.w+150,200);place(normal[2],view.x+650,view.y-200);Object.assign(p,{attack:0,attackCooldown:0,chainWindow:0});w.hitstop=0;return {visible:[normal[0].id,boss.id],offscreen:[normal[1].id,normal[2].id],view}});
 await page.click('#resume');await page.mouse.move(800,500);await page.mouse.down();await page.waitForTimeout(60);await page.mouse.up();await page.waitForTimeout(80);
 const kills=await page.evaluate(t=>{const w=__pixelQA.world();return {visible:t.visible.map(id=>w.enemies[id].dead),offscreen:t.offscreen.map(id=>w.enemies[id].dead),attack:w.player.attackId}},targets);assert.deepEqual(kills.visible,[true,true]);assert.deepEqual(kills.offscreen,[false,false]);ok(true,'Single mouse attack kills visible normal enemy and boss, preserving enemies outside view');
 await page.keyboard.press('Escape');await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__pixelQA.world();Object.assign(w.player,{x:75,y:180,vx:0,vy:0,hp:3,attackCooldown:0,chainWindow:0});w.hitstop=0});await page.keyboard.press('KeyG');await checkGodSynced(page,false);await page.click('#resume');const fallStart=await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y);await page.waitForTimeout(230);ok((await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y))>fallStart+15,'Disabling god mode restores gravity');
 const vulnerable=await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__pixelQA.world();w.player.invuln=0;w.player.dash=0;const hp=w.player.hp;return {hurt:w.hurt(1,w.player.x+100),hpBefore:hp,hpAfter:w.player.hp}});ok(vulnerable.hurt===true&&vulnerable.hpAfter===vulnerable.hpBefore-1,'Disabling god mode restores normal damage');
 await page.keyboard.press('Escape');await page.evaluate(()=>{const w=__pixelQA.world();w.hitstop=0;Object.assign(w.player,{x:75,y:378,vx:0,vy:0,grounded:true,hurt:0,attack:0,attackCooldown:0,chainWindow:0,face:1});const e=w.enemies.find(e=>e.type!=='boss');Object.assign(e,{x:500,y:390,baseY:390,home:{x:450,y:420,w:300},hp:e.maxHp,dead:false,timer:10,hitBy:-1});window.__normalTarget=e.id});await page.click('#resume');
 const serial=await page.evaluate(()=>__pixelQA.world().attackSerial);await page.mouse.move(800,500);await page.mouse.down({button:'left'});await page.waitForTimeout(1050);await page.mouse.up({button:'left'});ok((await page.evaluate(()=>__pixelQA.world().attackSerial))>=serial+3,'Holding left mouse preserves three-stage combo');ok(await page.evaluate(()=>{const e=__pixelQA.world().enemies[__normalTarget];return !e.dead&&e.hp===e.maxHp}),'Normal melee cannot damage distant visible enemy');
 await page.mouse.down({button:'right'});await page.waitForTimeout(55);const dash=await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.dashCooldown);await page.mouse.up({button:'right'});ok(dash>0,'Right mouse preserves dash');
 await page.keyboard.press('Escape');await page.click('#god-pause');await page.reload();await page.waitForFunction(()=>pixelInfo().loaded);await checkGodSynced(page,true);ok(true,'God preference persists and synchronized buttons restore');await context.close();
 for(const [width,height] of [[1440,900],[390,844],[360,640],[844,390]]){const mobile=width!==1440,{context,page}=await storageContext(browser,{[progressKey]:{version:1,completed:[true,true,false]}},{viewport:{width,height},isMobile:mobile,hasTouch:mobile});current=page;const name=`${width}x${height}`;await page.click('[data-level="2"]');await page.waitForTimeout(150);
  const menu=await fits(page,'#menu-characters button,[data-level],#god-menu,#start,#god-hud,#sound,#fullscreen',name+' menu');assert.equal(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth),false);await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,name+'-menu.png')});
  ok(!(await page.locator('body').innerText()).includes('星铃'),name+' contains no former Xingling character');await page.click('#start');await page.waitForTimeout(220);await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,name+'-game.png')});await page.click('#god-hud');await checkGodSynced(page,true);const game=await fits(page,mobile?'#god-hud,#pause,#touch button':'#god-hud,#pause',name+' god game');await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,name+'-god-game.png')});
  if(mobile){const y=await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y);const up=await page.locator('[data-key="jump"]').boundingBox();await page.mouse.move(up.x+up.width/2,up.y+up.height/2);await page.mouse.down();await page.waitForTimeout(210);await page.mouse.up();ok((await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y))<y-20,name+' accessible up touch button moves player');const raised=await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y),down=await page.locator('[data-key="down"]').boundingBox();await page.mouse.move(down.x+down.width/2,down.y+down.height/2);await page.mouse.down();await page.waitForTimeout(210);await page.mouse.up();ok((await page.evaluate(()=>pixelInfo().player.y))>raised+20,name+' accessible down touch button moves player')}
  await page.click('#pause');const pause=await fits(page,'#pause-characters button,#god-pause,#resume,#restart,#home',name+' pause');await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,name+'-pause.png')});report.layouts.push({width,height,menu,game,pause});await context.close();
 }
 assert.deepEqual(report.errors,[]);report.passed=true;fs.rmSync(path.join(out,'failure.png'),{force:true});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'results.json'),JSON.stringify(report,null,2));console.log(JSON.stringify({passed:true,checks:report.checks.length,layouts:report.layouts.length,errors:report.errors,artifacts:out}));
}catch(error){report.passed=false;report.failure=String(error.stack||error);if(current&&!current.isClosed())await current.screenshot({path:path.join(out,'failure.png')}).catch(()=>{});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'results.json'),JSON.stringify(report,null,2));throw error}finally{await browser.close()}
})().catch(error=>{console.error(error);process.exitCode=1});
